# Web{X} Studio

> Web{X} Studio is an international web design, development and SEO agency based in Ludhiana, India, building high-converting landing pages, websites and search-optimised digital products for founders and brands across India and worldwide.

Web{X} Studio (https://www.thewebxstudio.com) delivers website design, web development, SEO & performance, ERP & web apps, and pixel-perfect Figma-to-code conversion (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer, Unbounce). Design, engineering and motion under one roof. The studio serves founders and brands in India, the UK, the US and the Gulf. Contact: hello@thewebxstudio.com.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/): International web design, landing page & SEO agency.
- [Services](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/services): Website design, web development, SEO & performance, ERP & web apps, and Figma-to-code conversion.
- [Work](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/work): Selected web design, development and SEO projects built to convert and rank.
- [Studio](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/studio): About Web{X} — a small, senior team of designers and engineers.
- [Contact](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/contact): Start a project or request a quote (reply within 2 business days).
- [Careers](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/careers): Open roles at the studio.
- [Web Development Agency in Ludhiana](https://www.thewebxstudio.com/web-development-agency-ludhiana): Local service page — websites, SEO and web apps in Ludhiana.
